subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrowed policy that routes only known Google/Gemini auth-profile env refs through the generated systemd EnvironmentFile while other auth-profile env refs remain inline?
rationale: The code path and proof support the mechanics, but CI cannot decide the intended credential-delivery and provider-policy boundary for installed services.

options.title: Accept The Narrow File-Backed Policy
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer/security review agrees that Google/Gemini auth-profile keys should use the existing EnvironmentFile contract now.

options.title: Request A Generic Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR if the desired contract is to route all safe auth-profile env refs through a shared file-backed policy instead of a Google/Gemini allowlist.

options.title: Defer Auth-Profile Rendering
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the linked issue limited to config SecretRefs and plan auth-profile work separately.

recommendation.title: Accept The Narrow File-Backed Policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer/security review agrees that Google/Gemini auth-profile keys should use the existing EnvironmentFile contract now.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the related config SecretRef fix for the same issue and are the best evidenced maintainer-side routing candidate for this cluster.
